adapter_name.title: Name
adapter_name.description: Provide a unique name for this adapter instance. Example: minimax-1

model.title: Model
model.description: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash (default) or MiniMax-M3. Saved and custom model names remain supported. See [MiniMax's model docs](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/models-intro) and [pricing](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/pricing/overview).

api_base.title: API Base
api_base.description: MiniMax endpoint. Pre-filled with the global OpenAI-compatible base. A base whose path ends in `/anthropic` is sent using the Anthropic-compatible protocol; any other base uses the OpenAI-compatible protocol. China accounts use the `api.minimaxi.com` host. See [MiniMax API docs](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-openai-api).

service_tier.title: Service Tier
service_tier.description: Optional tier for MiniMax-M3; omission uses standard. MiniMax-M3.1-Flash does not support this parameter, so the adapter omits it even if a saved configuration contains a tier. See [MiniMax pricing](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/pricing/overview). Cost tracking records standard-tier rates.

max_tokens.title: Maximum Output Tokens
max_tokens.description: Maximum number of output tokens to limit LLM replies. Leave it empty to use the provider default.

max_retries.title: Max Retries
max_retries.description: The maximum number of times to retry a request if it fails.

enable_streaming.title: Enable Streaming
enable_streaming.description: Stream the model's reply and assemble it in the platform. Keeps the connection alive on long replies so a provider read timeout is not hit. Turn it off only for an endpoint that cannot stream.

enable_thinking.title: Enable Thinking
enable_thinking.description: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash requires adaptive thinking: omit this setting or enable it. MiniMax-M3 supports either setting; omission uses adaptive thinking for OpenAI and disabled thinking for Anthropic. MiniMax-M2.x models retain their always-on behavior. Effort is left to the API default. See [MiniMax API docs](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-chat-openai).
